# Vendored front-end libraries

Copied verbatim from the npm packages so the observatory works without internet access.

| File | Package | Version | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chart.umd.js` | chart.js | 4.4.1 | MIT | https://unpkg.com/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.js |
| `leaflet/leaflet.js`, `leaflet/leaflet.css` | leaflet | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause | https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/ |

To upgrade, download the new files from the same paths and update this table.
